baseline_flow.template: ./abc -c "read_lib {library}; read {design}; resyn; resyn2; dch -v; map; topo; buffer; upsize -v; dnsize -v; stime"

candidate_flow.template: ./abc -c "read_lib {library}; read {design}; resyn; resyn2; dch -v; {command}; topo; buffer; upsize -v; dnsize -v; stime"

correctness.pass_condition: new stmapN command and implementation files exist
correctness.fail_condition: missing numbered command, missing implementation, or skipped version number

correctness.pass_condition: usage text is printed for the new stmapN command; ABC help-path exit code 0 or 1 is acceptable
correctness.fail_condition: command missing, crashes before printing usage, or has no usage text

correctness.command_template: ./abc -c "read_lib 7nm_lvt_ff.lib; read benchmarks/i10.aig; resyn; resyn2; dch -v; {command}; topo; buffer; upsize -v; dnsize -v; stime"

correctness.expected_flow: for each required benchmark, write an original strashed temporary from `read_lib {library}; read {design}; strash`; write a candidate post-flow strashed temporary from the configured candidate flow plus `strash`; then run `./abc -c "cec <original_temp> <candidate_temp>"`
correctness.pass_condition: ABC cec reports equivalent for every required benchmark, or an explicitly logged alternate equivalence method is used only when direct cec is invalid for that benchmark format
correctness.fail_condition: cec failure, inconclusive result, crash, timeout, missing artifact, or unlogged equivalence exception

correctness.pass_condition: all four required benchmarks produce final stime_delay_ps and stime_area
correctness.fail_condition: any required benchmark missing, crashed, timed out, or unparseable

correctness.pass_condition: hypothesis, motivation, files, command, validation, benchmark results, correctness, review findings, commit, and next step are recorded
correctness.fail_condition: missing or incomplete version log entry

correctness.pass_condition: required review pass completes and accepted findings are addressed and revalidated
correctness.fail_condition: skipped required review, unresolved accepted finding, or no revalidation

required_artifacts: raw abc stdout/stderr for baseline and candidate flows
cec logs and temporary design paths

plot_requirements.layout_guidance: If two primary metrics dominate the study and have materially different scales, prefer dual-axis plots; otherwise split plots for readability.

commit_policy.per_successful_iteration: one coherent commit containing implementation, build integration, evaluation artifacts, and AutoEDA runtime log updates

push_policy.full_campaign: disabled by default; enable only after the user explicitly changes push_mode and confirms the remote target

safety_notes: The configured origin is https://github.com/Yu-Maryland/abc on branch master, so autonomous pushes are disabled in this pack.
Successful iterations may still create local commits when commit_policy requirements pass.
Do not run automatic pull --rebase or other history-rewriting recovery; preserve unrelated user and campaign changes.
